narrative.overview:
Mission Critical sits on a near-black bench. Reading surfaces are stone paper. Copper is the checked mark: the action, the assay figure, and the second line of the strapline. Names, headings, and numbers are Schibsted Grotesk. Reading is Literata. The hero is a designed film behind a bench-colored scrim, with the poster as the still state. Illustrations keep the existing copper, cyan, and violet family. The interface does not add violet chrome.

Density is editorial. One reading measure, wide section intervals, and a single record on the bench. Motion is the hero film and a short rise on the assay figure. Body copy does not move.
keyCharacteristics: Bench black field, stone-paper sheets, deep-copper closing band
Copper for the primary action, the assay figure, and the strapline's second line
Schibsted Grotesk for names and numbers, Literata for reading
Two-pixel controls, hairline rules, one soft shadow under illustrations
Designed hero motion behind a scrim; reading stays still

rules.name: The Assay Copper Rule
rules.body: Copper marks the thing to check or the thing to do: the primary action, the figure on paper, the strapline's second line, and the current page. The bench is not washed with it.

rules.name: The Paper Sheet Rule
rules.body: Stone paper is a full-bleed reading field. On it, text is paper ink, links and the figure are deep copper, and selection is deep copper with white text.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Schibsted Grotesk carries the name, the headings, the dateline, the figure, and the controls. Literata carries the reading. They do not swap.

rules.name: The Strapline Break Rule
rules.body: The compound "build-out" stays on one line. The next line is "is made of", in hot copper, at the same display size.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Reading stops at 66ch. The issue deck and the freshness line stop at 62ch. The hero dek stops at 38rem.

rules.name: The Tonal Bench Rule
rules.body: A region separates by changing field color. Buttons, the header, and the sheet do not receive a shadow.

rules.name: The Two-Pixel Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls use a 2px radius. Nothing else is rounded.

rules.name: The Current Underline Rule
rules.body: The active nav item is an inset 2px hot-copper line. It is not a filled chip.

rules.name: The Still Reading Rule
rules.body: The film may play, muted, and the assay figure may rise once. Reading text does not animate. Reduced motion starts on the still poster and clears the figure transform.

dos: Do set the page on bench black with specimen ink, and set reading on stone paper with paper ink.
Do use Schibsted Grotesk for the name, headings, datelines, figures, and controls, and Literata for reading.
Do keep "build-out" on the strapline's first line and set "is made of" in hot copper.
Do mark the current page with an inset 2px hot-copper line, and show keyboard focus as a 2px focus-cyan outline, 3px offset.
Do keep the hero muted, and start from the poster when reduced motion is requested.
donts: Don't set reading text in Schibsted Grotesk, or headings in Literata.
Don't round controls past 2px, or round the sheets, bands, or illustrations.
Don't add a shadow to anything but the illustration plates. The plate shadow is 0 16px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28).
Don't use furnace copper as a large bench fill. The deep-copper closing band is the one full-bleed copper field.
Don't animate paragraphs, headings, or captions. The only text motion is the assay figure, and it is removed when reduced motion is on or scripting is off.
